        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-01')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'

                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )

/* cppi::601bfb9f6cc00cd632501872736ef688b04a5cabec170f4f38f80675fd70137b */
/* QuickSight 074253fb-c29f-4554-994d-4f5d62e235c2 */
SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

/* cppi::b1d1e60304135e3b1c78af0217bc0efe75933b82e6f0731424cb66b38a0a7d6a */
WITH analytic_pv AS
    (select sd.business_date, analytic_value
     from radar_reporting_uat
    .fact_analytic_sd sd
    join radar_reporting_uat.dim_hierarchy_node dh
on sd.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dh.dim_hierarchy_node_id and dh.node_level=2 and dh.node_name ='BCPP' and sd.business_date = dh.business_date

where analytic_type = 'PV'
  and portfolio_type = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
  and sd.business_date = '2025-05-29'
    )
select ule.party_name,
       ule.gics_sector,
       sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure)                                 as credit_exposure,
       pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit as single_name_limit,
       case
           when ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit > 0 then round(sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) /
                                                                (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit) *
                                                                100, 1)
           else 0 end as usage,
    CASE
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit) BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.949999999
            THEN 'Yellow Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit) BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.999999999
            THEN 'Orange Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) >= (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit)
            THEN 'Breach'
        ELSE 'OK'
END
AS status

from radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure f
         join radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity le on f.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = le.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and f.business_date = le.business_date
         join radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity ule on le.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = ule.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit is not null and ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit != -1 and f.business_date = ule.business_date

         left join analytic_pv pv on f.business_date = pv.business_date
where f.bcpp_credit_exposure is not null
  and f.business_date = '2025-05-29'
group by ule.party_name, ule.gics_sector, ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit, pv.analytic_value
order by sum(bcpp_credit_exposure) desc

  reference.risk_rating,
  reference.investment_department_id,
  reference.investment_status,
  reference.investment_lifecycle,
  reference.sector,
  reference.maturity_date AS maturity_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- other staging
  --------------------------------------
  COALESCE(staging.funding_currency, staging.deal_currency) AS funding_currency, 
  CASE
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm >= 0 THEN 'Deployment'
    ELSE 'Disposition'
  END AS deployment_disposition,
  COALESCE(staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm, 0) * (COALESCE(staging.probability_of_close, 0) / 100.0) AS probability_weighted_investment_amount_local,
  staging.funded_amount,
  staging.quantity_net,
  staging.market_value,
  staging.portfolio_name,
  staging.sentry_security_type,
  staging.price_multiplier,
  staging.quantity_multiplier,
  staging.debt_factor,
  staging.model_portfolio_id,
  staging.ticket_number,
  --------------------------------------
  -- fixed-values specified in BRD
  --------------------------------------
  staging.probability_of_close AS probability_of_close,
  'Binding' AS binding,
  'Net Purchases and Sales' AS capital_usage_component,
  'Investment Funding/Distribution' AS transaction_cash_flow_type,
  'Y' AS send_to_treasury_y_n,
  --------------------------------------
  -- 'expected'-related fields
  --------------------------------------
  staging.expected_funding_date,
  staging.expected_trade_date,
  staging.expected_exit_price,
  staging.expected_exit_probability,
  staging.expected_exit_date,
  (COALESCE(staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm, 0) * -1) AS expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm,
  --------------------------------------
  -- will be calculated by python code
  --------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------
  -- created by and updated by fields
  --------------------------------------
  staging.last_updated_by,
  staging.last_updated_date,
  staging.created_by_user_group,
  staging.created_by,
  staging.date_updated,
  --------------------------------------
  -- source business dates
  --------------------------------------
  staging.business_date AS staging_src_business_date,
  reference.business_date AS reference_src_business_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- comment and error
  --------------------------------------
  staging.comment,
  staging.error,
  --------------------------------------
  -- NULL on purpose (from requirements)
  --------------------------------------
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_required,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount,
  NULL AS fo_comments,
  NULL AS pec_recusals,
  NULL AS pec_pipeline_y_n,
  NULL AS fx_spot,
  NULL AS full_amt_cad_mm,
  NULL AS rejected_deals_reason,
  --------------------------------------
  -- investigate these
  --------------------------------------
  -- staging.investment_program
  -- reference.investment_strategy
  -- reference.investment_group
  -- staging.tfm_inv_sub_strategy
  --------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------

  END AS deployment_disposition,
  COALESCE(staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm, 0) * (COALESCE(staging.probability_of_close, 0) / 100.0) AS probability_weighted_investment_amount_local,

  staging.created_by_user_group,
  staging.created_by,
  staging.date_updated,
  --------------------------------------
  -- source business dates
  --------------------------------------
  staging.business_date AS staging_src_business_date,
  reference.business_date AS reference_src_business_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- comment and error
  --------------------------------------
  staging.comment,
  staging.error,
  --------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_required,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount,
  NULL AS fo_comments,

  NULL AS pec_pipeline_y_n,
  NULL AS fx_spot,
  NULL AS full_amt_cad_mm,
  NULL AS rejected_deals_reason,
  --------------------------------------
  -- investigate these
  --------------------------------------
  -- staging.investment_program
  -- reference.investment_strategy
  -- reference.investment_group
  -- staging.tfm_inv_sub_strategy
  --------------------------------------
  -- helpful debug information

  'ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_unsettled_transactions_staging, ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference' AS data_sources_list
  --------------------------------------

  staging.run_id = '301a52ab-9eea-4fb7-b120-e9f6c6b0a8f8'

	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025

		AND day = 03
		AND hour between 16 and 17

	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-03 16:05:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')

		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

with cte as
(
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ISIN ORDER BY (CASE WHEN cppib_sec_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END), cppib_sec_id) AS rn
    from asset.asset_bonds
    where business_date = date'2025-05-23'
),
cmb as
(
    select
		id_cppib_security,
		maturity_bucket
	from (
		select distinct
			id_cppib_security,
			maturity_bucket,
			row_number() over (
				partition by id_cppib_security
				order by 
					case when feed_name like 'lbfi_%' then 1 else 2 end,
					cast(
						case
							when position('-' in maturity_bucket) > 1 then substr(maturity_bucket, 1, position('-' in maturity_bucket) - 1)
							else null
						end as integer
					) asc
			) as row_num
		from market.cppib_maturity_bucket
    	where business_date = date'2025-05-23' and maturity_bucket is not null and maturity_bucket != ''
	)
	where row_num = 1
)
select
    fsb.business_date,
    'IR_FSB_Benchmark_Supp' as benchmark_name,
    fsb."investment cell" as category,
    null as id_cppib_index,
    'tfm_bp_fsb_benchmark_supp' as feed_name,
    fsb.indexID as index_name,
    cte.instrument_description as security_name,
    'Fixed Income' as asset_type,
    cte.sedol as sedol,
    cte.cusip as cusip,
    cte.isin as isin,
    ms.type,
    ms.sub_type,
    fsb.priceEOP as last_value_eod,
    fsb.priceEOP as last_value_ndo,
    fsb."benchmark weight" as weight_eod,
    fsb."benchmark weight" as weight_ndo,
    p.party_name as issuer_name,
    cte.cppib_sec_id as id_cppib_security,
    cte.currency_code as iso_currency_eod,
    cte.country_code as country_domicile,
    cte.listing_country_code as country_listing,
    cte.region_code as region,
    ms.cppib_market_capitalization_size_code as market_capitalization_size_code,
    cte.country_code as country_reference_code_eod,
    fsb."benchmark weight" as benchmark_constituent_weight,
    null as sub_component,
    sr.rating_value as security_rating,
    pr.rating_value as issuer_rating,
    null as developed_market_flag,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_code_1 as classification_code_1,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_name_1 as classification_code_1_description,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_code_2 as classification_code_2,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_name_2 as classification_code_2_description,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_code_3 as classification_code_3,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_name_3 as classification_code_3_description,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_code_4 as classification_code_4,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_name_4 as classification_code_4_description,
    null as alternate_listing,
    rc.country_name,
    fsb.mrktValue as market_capitalization_base_eod,
    null as investable_shares_eod,
    cte.trade_currency_code as iso_currency_local,
    null as quality,
    cmb.maturity_bucket as maturity_bucket
from market.tfm_bp_fsb_benchmark_supp fsb
left join cte
    on fsb.business_date = cte.business_date and fsb.isin = cte.isin and cte.rn = 1
left join cmb

/* cppi::0f41e96ee477c2ddfedbdbe490c29ea00e2a3775804529f01c30226158f986ab */
with date_adjusted as (
    select business_date, rm_id, rm_value, rm_name, arrival_time,
        case
            when True and rm_name = 'cashRate' then date_add('day', 1, business_date)
            else business_date
        end as business_date_adj
    from market.tfm_risk_model_daily
    where business_date between date_add('day', -1, date '2025-04-29') and date '2025-04-29'
    and to_date(substring(cast(arrival_time as varchar), 1, 8), 'yyyymmdd') <= date '2025-12-31'
),
max_arrival_time as (
    select *,
        max(arrival_time) over (partition by rm_id, business_date_adj) as max_publish
    from date_adjusted
    where business_date_adj between date '2025-04-29' and date '2025-04-29'
)
select business_date, business_date_adj, rm_id, rm_value, rm_name
from max_arrival_time
where arrival_time = max_publish

SELECT ctev.companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
            country, countrycode, city, region,
            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency,
            cf.period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency,
            investor_id, investor_name, ci.period_end_date as investment_period_end_date,
            percent_of_shares_outstanding as investor_percent_of_shares,
            rank_of_shares_held as investor_rank_of_shares_held
            FROM
            (-- Get company data +TEV
            SELECT companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
                            country, countrycode, city, region,
                            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
                            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT c.companyid, c.companyname, bd.business_description,
                                c.yearfounded, c.webpage,
                                ti.tickersymbol||':'||e.exchange_symbol AS ticker,
                                g.country, g.iso_country_2 AS countrycode, c.city, g.region,
                                c.simpleindustryid,
                                si.simple_industry_description AS simpleindustry,
                                mc.pricingdate,
                                max(pricingdate) over (PARTITION BY c.companyid) AS maxpricingdate,
                                mc.TEV, cur.isocode AS tev_currency
                            FROM capiq_company c
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_business_description bd ON
                                c.companyid = bd.company_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqsimpleindustry si ON
                                c.simpleindustryid = si.simple_industry_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqcountrygeo g ON c.countryid = g.country_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqMarketCap mc ON c.companyid = mc.companyid
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON mc.companyId=s.companyId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_exchange e ON e.exchange_id = ti.exchangeId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                            WHERE s.primaryFlag=1
                                AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                                AND simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                                AND companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating
                                                                -- 2=Operating Subsidiary
                                AND companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                                AND ((mc.TEV > 0 and cur.isocode is not null) OR mc.TEV IS NULL)
                                AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%2'
                )
            WHERE pricingdate=maxpricingdate
            ) AS ctev
            LEFT JOIN
            (-- Get LTM fundamentals for Public operating companies
            SELECT DISTINCT company_id,
                period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT f.company_id,
                    max(fiscal_chain_id) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxfiscalchainid,
                    fiscal_chain_id,
                    max(period_end_date) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxperiodenddate,
                    period_end_date,
                    CASE capiq_item_id
                        WHEN 112 THEN 'LTM_Revenue'
                        WHEN 4051 THEN 'LTM_EBITDA'
                    END AS capiq_item,
                    value_ltm, f.currency AS kpi_currency
                FROM cppib_party_fundamental_pit_capiq f
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_company c ON f.company_id = c.companyid
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON f.company_id=s.companyId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                WHERE c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating 2=Operating Subsidiary
                    AND c.companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                    AND s.primaryFlag=1
                    AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                    AND f.pit_date = '2025-06-03'
                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%2'
                )
            WHERE period_end_date = maxperiodenddate AND
                fiscal_chain_id = maxfiscalchainid AND
                capiq_item IS NOT NULL
            ) AS cf
            ON ctev.companyid = cf.company_id
            LEFT JOIN
            (select company_id, company_name, investor_id, investor_name, period_end_date,
                    percent_of_shares_outstanding, rank_of_shares_held
            from (select o.company_id, c.companyname as company_name,
                        o.owner_object_id as investor_id,
                        i.companyname as investor_name, o.period_end_date,
                        o.percent_of_shares_outstanding,
                        o.rank_of_shares_held,
                        max(period_end_date) over (partition by o.company_id)
                        as max_period_end_date
                from cppib_party_ownership_pit_capiq o
                    left join capiq_company c on o.company_id = c.companyid
                    left join capiq_company i on o.owner_object_id = i.companyid
                where pit_date_str = '2025-06-03'
                    and o.is_latest_flag = 1
                    AND o.rank_of_shares_held IS NOT NULL
                    AND o.rank_of_shares_held <6
                    AND c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating 2=Operating Subsidiary
                    AND c.companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%2'
            )
        where period_end_date = max_period_end_date) AS ci
            ON ctev.companyid = ci.company_id

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 03
		AND hour between 02 and 03
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-03 02:43:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 03
		AND hour between 17 and 18
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-03 17:46:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT

			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 03
		AND hour between 13 and 14
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-03 13:58:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

with old_breached_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        max(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'N'
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
new_breached_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        min(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_breached_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
first_breach_date as (
    select *
    from old_breached_records
    union all
    select *
    from new_breached_records
),
old_alert_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        max(business_date) first_alert_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_alert = 'N'
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
new_alert_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        min(business_date) first_alert_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_alert = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_alert_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
first_alert_date as (
    select *
    from old_alert_records
    union all
    select *
    from new_alert_records
)
SELECT a.*,
    b.first_breach_date,
    c.first_alert_date,
    date_diff(
        'day',
        cast(b.first_breach_date as date),
        cast(a.business_date as date)
    ) num_of_breach_days,

        'day',
        cast(c.first_alert_date as date),
        cast(a.business_date as date)
    ) num_of_alert_days

    left outer join first_breach_date b on a.limit_name = b.limit_name
    and a.limit_id = b.limit_id
    left outer join first_alert_date c on a.limit_name = c.limit_name

                            CASE si.market_sector_desc

/* cppi::d57e9a7cfc34dd28bd23065acaf75dab07b18c79cfd4f4e00fde49ac7a36eaf8 */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 03
		AND hour between 22 and 23
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-03 22:33:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::266f5c8257c0356be9b105b28c52e5bbbd3e96d38b3125a59f8693f881b26a96 */
WITH prev_business_date AS
         (
             SELECT
                 max(fact.business_date) as business_date
             FROM radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact
             WHERE
                 fact.business_date < '2025-06-02'
         ),
	current_exposure AS
	  (
	    SELECT
	      child.party_name,
	      child.cppib_party_id,
	      child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
		  child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	      coalesce( country.name, child.domicile_country_code ) AS country_code,
	      child.rtg_final AS rtg_final,
	      child.rtg_outlook AS rtg_outlook,

	      SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.st_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS st_exposure,
		  MAX( child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS st_smd_threshold,

		  SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.mt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS mt_exposure,
		  MAX( child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS mt_smd_threshold,

		  SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.lt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS lt_exposure,
		  MAX( child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS lt_smd_threshold
	    FROM
	      radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,
	      radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
	      radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos,
	      radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
		LEFT JOIN radar_reporting_prod.ref_country country ON country.business_date = parent.business_date and parent.domicile_country_code = country.alpha_2_code
	    WHERE
	      fact.business_date = '2025-06-02'
		  and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
		  and fact.business_date = child.business_date
		  and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
		  AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
	      AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) <> 'NETTING'
	      AND
	        (
	          parent.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR EXISTS
	            (
	              SELECT 1
	              FROM radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
	              WHERE
	                parent.business_date = sibling.business_date 
					and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
	             )
	        )
	      AND (
			EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
			OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
		  )
          AND child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id != child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	    GROUP BY
	      child.party_name,
	      child.cppib_party_id,
	      child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
		  child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	      coalesce( country.name, child.domicile_country_code ),
	      child.rtg_final,
	      child.rtg_outlook
	  ),
	prev_exposure AS
	  (
	    SELECT
	      child.party_name,
		  child.cppib_party_id,
	      child.rtg_final AS prev_rtg_final,
	      SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.st_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS prev_st_exposure,
		  SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.mt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS prev_mt_exposure,
		  SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.lt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS prev_lt_exposure
	    FROM
	      prev_business_date p
	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child
		    ON child.business_date = p.business_date
	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact
		    ON child.business_date = fact.business_date and fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
		    ON child.business_date = parent.business_date and child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
		    ON fact.business_date = pos.business_date and fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
			AND UPPER( pos.PRODUCT_TYPE ) <> 'NETTING'
	    WHERE
	        (
	          parent.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR EXISTS
	            (
	              SELECT 1
	              FROM radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
	              WHERE
					parent.business_date = sibling.business_date
	                and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
	             )
	        )
	      AND (
			EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
			OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
		  )
          AND child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id != child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		GROUP BY
	      child.cppib_party_id,
	      child.party_name,
	      child.rtg_final
	  ),
	  child_level_exp_limits AS
	    (
	      SELECT
	        parent.cppib_party_id AS cppib_party_id_parent,
	        child.cppib_party_id AS cppib_party_id_child,
	        SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.st_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS st_exposure,
	        MAX( child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS st_smd_threshold,
	        SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.mt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS mt_exposure,
	        MAX( child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS mt_smd_threshold,
	        SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.lt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS lt_exposure,
	        MAX( child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS lt_smd_threshold
	      FROM
	        radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,
	        radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent,
	        radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
	        radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
	      WHERE
	        fact.business_date = '2025-06-02'
		    and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
		    and fact.business_date = child.business_date
		    and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
	        AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	        AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	        AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
	        AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) <> 'NETTING'
	        AND
	          (
	            parent.is_fi = 'Y'
	            OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
	            OR EXISTS
	              (
	                SELECT 1
	                FROM radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
	                WHERE
	                  parent.business_date = sibling.business_date
					  and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                  AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                  AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
	               )
	          )
			AND (
				EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
				OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
			  )
            AND child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id != child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      GROUP BY
	        parent.cppib_party_id,
	        child.cppib_party_id
	    ),
	  breaches_under_parents AS
	    (
			SELECT
            	cppib_party_id_parent AS cppib_party_id,
            	MIN
				  (
	                CASE
                        WHEN st_exposure / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
                            OR mt_exposure / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
                            OR lt_exposure / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
                            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                        WHEN st_exposure / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                            OR mt_exposure / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                            OR lt_exposure / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                            THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
	                    WHEN st_exposure >= st_smd_threshold OR mt_exposure >= mt_smd_threshold OR lt_exposure >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	                    ELSE 'OK'
	                END
	              ) AS status
            FROM child_level_exp_limits
            GROUP BY
            	cppib_party_id_parent
    	)
	SELECT
	  'Y' AS has_children,
	  c.party_name,
	  CASE
          WHEN SUM(st_exposure) / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              OR SUM(mt_exposure) / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              OR SUM(lt_exposure) / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
          WHEN SUM(st_exposure) / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
              OR SUM(mt_exposure) / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
              OR SUM(lt_exposure) / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
              THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
	      WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= st_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	      WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= mt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	      WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
		  ELSE coalesce( MIN( b.status ), 'OK' )
	  END AS status,
	  CASE
	    WHEN country_code = 'United States' THEN 'US'
		WHEN country_code = 'United Kingdom' THEN 'UK'
		ELSE country_code
	  END AS country_code,
	  coalesce( rtg_final, '-' ) AS rtg_final,
	  coalesce( rtg_outlook, '-' ) AS rtg_outlook,

	  SUM( st_exposure ) / 1000000 AS st_exposure,
	  coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( st_exposure ) - SUM( prev_st_exposure ) ) / 1000000)), '-' )  AS st_change_exposure,
      coalesce(st_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS st_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate(st_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(st_exposure)) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS st_available,
      CASE
          WHEN st_smd_threshold = 0 OR st_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
          ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( st_exposure ) ) / st_smd_threshold * 100
      END AS st_utilization,

	  SUM( mt_exposure ) / 1000000 AS mt_exposure,
	  coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate((SUM( mt_exposure ) - SUM( prev_mt_exposure ) ) / 1000000)), '-' )  AS mt_change_exposure,
      coalesce(mt_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS mt_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate((mt_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(mt_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS mt_available,
      CASE
          WHEN mt_smd_threshold = 0 OR mt_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
          ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( mt_exposure ) ) / mt_smd_threshold * 100
      END AS mt_utilization,

	  SUM( lt_exposure ) / 1000000 AS lt_exposure,
	  coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( lt_exposure ) - SUM( prev_lt_exposure ) ) / 1000000)), '-' )  AS lt_change_exposure,
      coalesce(lt_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS lt_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate((lt_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(lt_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS lt_available,
      CASE
          WHEN lt_smd_threshold = 0 OR lt_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
          ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( lt_exposure ) ) / lt_smd_threshold * 100
      END AS lt_utilization,

	  MAX( p.prev_rtg_final ) AS prev_rtg_final,
	  dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= st_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS st_limit_blown,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= mt_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS mt_limit_blown,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS lt_limit_blown
	FROM current_exposure c

	LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id = b.cppib_party_id AND 'child' = 'parent'
	LEFT JOIN prev_exposure p
	  ON c.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
	  OR c.party_name = p.party_name
	GROUP BY
        st_smd_threshold,
        mt_smd_threshold,
        lt_smd_threshold,
	  dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  c.party_name,
	  country_code,
	  rtg_final,
	  rtg_outlook
    ORDER BY
		CASE
            WHEN status = 'YELLOW ALERT' THEN 1
            WHEN status = 'ORANGE ALERT' THEN 2
            WHEN status = 'EXCESS' THEN 3
            ELSE 4
		END,
		ST_EXPOSURE DESC,
		party_name ASC

	SELECT
	  'Y' AS has_children,
	  c.party_name,
	  CASE
          WHEN SUM(st_exposure) / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              OR SUM(mt_exposure) / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              OR SUM(lt_exposure) / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
          WHEN SUM(st_exposure) / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
              OR SUM(mt_exposure) / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
              OR SUM(lt_exposure) / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
              THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
	      WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= st_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	      WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= mt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	      WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
		  ELSE coalesce( MIN( b.status ), 'OK' )
	  END AS status,
	  CASE
	    WHEN country_code = 'United States' THEN 'US'
		WHEN country_code = 'United Kingdom' THEN 'UK'
		ELSE country_code
	  END AS country_code,
	  coalesce( rtg_final, '-' ) AS rtg_final,
	  coalesce( rtg_outlook, '-' ) AS rtg_outlook,

	  SUM( st_exposure ) / 1000000 AS st_exposure,
	  coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( st_exposure ) - SUM( prev_st_exposure ) ) / 1000000)), '-' )  AS st_change_exposure,
      coalesce(st_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS st_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate(st_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(st_exposure)) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS st_available,
      CASE
          WHEN st_smd_threshold = 0 OR st_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
          ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( st_exposure ) ) / st_smd_threshold * 100
      END AS st_utilization,

	  SUM( mt_exposure ) / 1000000 AS mt_exposure,
	  coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate((SUM( mt_exposure ) - SUM( prev_mt_exposure ) ) / 1000000)), '-' )  AS mt_change_exposure,
      coalesce(mt_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS mt_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate((mt_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(mt_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS mt_available,
      CASE
          WHEN mt_smd_threshold = 0 OR mt_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
          ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( mt_exposure ) ) / mt_smd_threshold * 100
      END AS mt_utilization,

	  SUM( lt_exposure ) / 1000000 AS lt_exposure,
	  coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( lt_exposure ) - SUM( prev_lt_exposure ) ) / 1000000)), '-' )  AS lt_change_exposure,
      coalesce(lt_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS lt_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate((lt_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(lt_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS lt_available,
      CASE
          WHEN lt_smd_threshold = 0 OR lt_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
          ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( lt_exposure ) ) / lt_smd_threshold * 100
      END AS lt_utilization,

	  MAX( p.prev_rtg_final ) AS prev_rtg_final,
	  dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= st_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS st_limit_blown,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= mt_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS mt_limit_blown,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS lt_limit_blown
	FROM current_exposure c

	LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id = b.cppib_party_id AND 'child' = 'parent'
	LEFT JOIN prev_exposure p
	  ON c.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
	  OR c.party_name = p.party_name
	GROUP BY
        st_smd_threshold,
        mt_smd_threshold,
        lt_smd_threshold,
	  dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  c.party_name,
	  country_code,
	  rtg_final,
	  rtg_outlook
    ORDER BY
		CASE
            WHEN status = 'YELLOW ALERT' THEN 1
            WHEN status = 'ORANGE ALERT' THEN 2
            WHEN status = 'EXCESS' THEN 3
            ELSE 4
		END,
		ST_EXPOSURE DESC,
		party_name ASC

        FROM (

			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (

						ORDER BY date

 FROM (

		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 03
		AND hour between 15 and 16

		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-03 15:35:24'

	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

            coalesce( parent_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code ) AS "country_code_parent",

            parent.rtg_outlook AS "rtg_outlook_parent",

                    child.cppib_party_id AS "cppib_party_id_child",  
            coalesce( child_country.name, child.domicile_country_code ) AS "country_code_child",  
            child.rtg_final AS "rtg_final_child",  
                    child.rtg_outlook AS "rtg_outlook_child",  
            SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND pos.days_to_maturity = 1 THEN fact.credit_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS "exposure_expiring",  
            SUM(  
                   CASE  
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND  
                   ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )

                   THEN fact.st_exposure
                   ELSE 0
                   END
            ) AS "st_exposure",
            child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit AS "st_smd_threshold",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
             ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )

                           THEN fact.mt_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "mt_exposure",
            child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit AS "mt_smd_threshold",
                    SUM(
                            CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )

                    ) AS "lt_exposure",
            child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit AS "lt_smd_threshold",
                    SUM(
                            CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                            THEN fact.credit_exposure
                            ELSE 0
                           END
                    ) AS "total_cash_pb_exposure",
            child.total_cash_pb_smd_fi_limit AS "total_cash_pb_smd_limit",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and p.product_type_category = 'REPOS' AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "repo_sbl_exposure",
            child.repo_fi_limit AS "repo_sbl_smd_threshold",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and p.product_type_category = 'DERIVATIVES' AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "der_exposure",
            child.der_fi_limit AS "der_smd_threshold",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "total_der_repo_sbl_exposure",
            child.der_repo_fi_limit AS "total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           (
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) OR
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                           )
                           THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "isrc_total_exposure",
            child.isrc_total_fi_limit AS "isrc_total_limit",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           (
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) OR
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                           )
                           THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "smd_total_exposure",
            child.smd_total_fi_limit AS smd_total_limit
            FROM dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child
            INNER JOIN fact_cr_exposure fact
            ON fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and fact.chron_id = child.chron_id
            INNER JOIN dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
            ON child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and parent.chron_id = child.chron_id
            INNER JOIN dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
            ON fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id and pos.chron_id = fact.chron_id
            LEFT OUTER JOIN ref_country parent_country
            ON parent.domicile_country_code = parent_country.alpha_2_code and parent.chron_id = parent_country.chron_id
            LEFT OUTER JOIN ref_country child_country
            ON child.domicile_country_code = child_country.alpha_2_code and child_country.chron_id = child.chron_id
            WHERE
            child.business_date = '2025-06-02'
            AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) <> 'NETTING'
            AND
                    (
                            parent.is_fi = 'Y'
                            OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
                            OR EXISTS
                                    (
                                            SELECT 1
                                            FROM dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
                                            WHERE
                                            sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id

                           AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
                    )
                )
            GROUP BY
            parent.party_name,
                    parent.cppib_party_id,
                    coalesce( parent_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code ),
                    parent.rtg_final,
                    parent.rtg_outlook,

                    child.repo_fi_limit,

                    child.smd_total_fi_limit

                           WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= MAX( mt_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= MAX( lt_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'

            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) ), 2 )   AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "total_cash_pb_available",
                           coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "repo_sbl_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "repo_sbl_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "repo_sbl_available",
                           coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "der_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "der_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( der_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( der_exposure ) ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "der_available",
                           coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "total_der_repo_sbl_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "total_der_repo_sbl_available",
                           coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "isrc_total_exposure",
             coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "isrc_total_limit",
             coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( isrc_total_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
             AS "isrc_total_available",
                           coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "smd_total_exposure",
             coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( smd_total_limit ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "smd_total_limit",
             coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( smd_total_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( smd_total_exposure ) ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
             AS "smd_total_available",
                            cppib_party_id_parent AS cppib_party_id
            FROM curr_exposure c
            /* The following join is only used when querying at parent level */
            LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id_parent = b.cppib_party_id
            GROUP BY
            party_name_parent, country_code_parent, rtg_final_parent, rtg_outlook_parent, cppib_party_id_parent,
    b.status--, 'Y', coalesce( rtg_final_parent, '0' ), coalesce( rtg_outlook_parent, '0' )
            UNION ALL
            SELECT
                   is_parent,
                   entity_name,
                   parent_name,
                   status,
                   country_code_child,
                   rtg_final,
                   rtg_outlook,
                   exposure_expiring,
                   st_exposure,
                   st_smd_threshold,
                   st_available,
                   mt_exposure,
                   mt_smd_threshold,
                   mt_available,
                    lt_exposure,
                    lt_smd_threshold,
                    lt_available,
                    total_cash_pb_exposure,
                    total_cash_pb_smd_limit,
                    total_cash_pb_available,
                    repo_sbl_exposure,
                    repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
                    repo_sbl_available,
                   der_exposure,
                    der_smd_threshold,
                    der_available,
                    total_der_repo_sbl_exposure,
                    total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
                    total_der_repo_sbl_available,
                    isrc_total_exposure,
                    isrc_total_limit,
                    isrc_total_available,
                    smd_total_exposure,

                   cppib_party_id_child
            FROM child_level_exp_limits
            ORDER BY parent_name,is_parent DESC,entity_name

/* cppi::c6536acdff90b65f4ac562a2bb82bb47eb82ded9f7ae7567162dc9571545df0d */
WITH curr_exposure AS
            ( 
                    SELECT
             parent.party_name AS "party_name_parent",  
            parent.cppib_party_id AS "cppib_party_id_parent",  
            coalesce( parent_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code ) AS "country_code_parent",  
            parent.rtg_final AS "rtg_final_parent",  
            parent.rtg_outlook AS "rtg_outlook_parent",  
            child.party_name AS "party_name_child",  
                    child.cppib_party_id AS "cppib_party_id_child",  
            coalesce( child_country.name, child.domicile_country_code ) AS "country_code_child",  
            child.rtg_final AS "rtg_final_child",  
                    child.rtg_outlook AS "rtg_outlook_child",  
            SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND pos.days_to_maturity = 1 THEN fact.credit_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS "exposure_expiring",  
            SUM(  
                   CASE  
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND  
                   ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                   OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                   THEN fact.st_exposure
                   ELSE 0
                   END
            ) AS "st_exposure",
            child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit AS "st_smd_threshold",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
             ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                           OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                           THEN fact.mt_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "mt_exposure",
            child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit AS "mt_smd_threshold",
                    SUM(
                            CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                            THEN fact.lt_exposure
                            ELSE 0
                            END
                    ) AS "lt_exposure",
            child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit AS "lt_smd_threshold",
                    SUM(
                            CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                            THEN fact.credit_exposure
                            ELSE 0
                           END
                    ) AS "total_cash_pb_exposure",
            child.total_cash_pb_smd_fi_limit AS "total_cash_pb_smd_limit",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and p.product_type_category = 'REPOS' AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "repo_sbl_exposure",
            child.repo_fi_limit AS "repo_sbl_smd_threshold",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and p.product_type_category = 'DERIVATIVES' AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "der_exposure",
            child.der_fi_limit AS "der_smd_threshold",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "total_der_repo_sbl_exposure",
            child.der_repo_fi_limit AS "total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           (
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) OR
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                           )
                           THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "isrc_total_exposure",
            child.isrc_total_fi_limit AS "isrc_total_limit",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           (
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) OR
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-02' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                           )
                           THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "smd_total_exposure",
            child.smd_total_fi_limit AS smd_total_limit
            FROM dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child
            INNER JOIN fact_cr_exposure fact
            ON fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and fact.chron_id = child.chron_id
            INNER JOIN dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
            ON child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and parent.chron_id = child.chron_id
            INNER JOIN dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
            ON fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id and pos.chron_id = fact.chron_id
            LEFT OUTER JOIN ref_country parent_country
            ON parent.domicile_country_code = parent_country.alpha_2_code and parent.chron_id = parent_country.chron_id
            LEFT OUTER JOIN ref_country child_country
            ON child.domicile_country_code = child_country.alpha_2_code and child_country.chron_id = child.chron_id
            WHERE
            child.business_date = '2025-06-02'
            AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) <> 'NETTING'
            AND
                    (
                            parent.is_fi = 'Y'
                            OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
                            OR EXISTS
                                    (
                                            SELECT 1
                                            FROM dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
                                            WHERE
                                            sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                            AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                            AND sibling.chron_id = child.chron_id
                           AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
                    )
                )
            GROUP BY
            parent.party_name,
                    parent.cppib_party_id,
                    coalesce( parent_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code ),
                    parent.rtg_final,
                    parent.rtg_outlook,
                    child.party_name,
                    child.cppib_party_id,
                    coalesce( child_country.name, child.domicile_country_code ),
                    child.rtg_final,
                    child.rtg_outlook,
                    child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit,
                    child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit,
                    child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit,
                    child.total_cash_pb_smd_fi_limit,
                    child.repo_fi_limit,
                    child.der_fi_limit,
                    child.der_repo_fi_limit,
                    child.isrc_total_fi_limit,
                    child.smd_total_fi_limit
            ),
            child_level_exp_limits AS
            (
                    SELECT
            'N' AS "is_parent",
            party_name_child AS "entity_name",
                    party_name_parent AS "parent_name",
                    CASE
                           WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= MAX( st_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= MAX( mt_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= MAX( lt_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) >= MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( der_exposure ) >= MAX( der_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) >= MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ) THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) >= MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ) THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) >= MAX( isrc_total_limit ) THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN SUM( smd_total_exposure ) >= MAX( smd_total_limit ) THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
            ELSE 'OK'
            END AS "status",
                   country_code_child,
                    coalesce( rtg_final_child, '-' ) AS "rtg_final",
            coalesce( rtg_outlook_child, '-' ) AS "rtg_outlook",
            CAST (ROUND( SUM( exposure_expiring ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "exposure_expiring",
            CAST (ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "st_exposure",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "st_smd_threshold",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( st_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( st_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) , '-')
            AS "st_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "mt_exposure",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "mt_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( mt_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( mt_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-')
            AS "mt_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ), 2)  AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "lt_exposure",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "lt_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( lt_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( lt_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-')
            AS "lt_available",
                    /* Comment this out until GCM can handle these new fields after July 7, 2017 Abacus 3.1 release */
                   coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "total_cash_pb_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "total_cash_pb_smd_limit",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)), '-')
            AS "total_cash_pb_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "repo_sbl_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "repo_sbl_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "repo_sbl_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "der_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "der_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( der_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( der_exposure ) ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "der_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "total_der_repo_sbl_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-')
            AS "total_der_repo_sbl_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "isrc_total_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "isrc_total_limit",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( isrc_total_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "isrc_total_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "smd_total_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( smd_total_limit ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "smd_total_limit",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( smd_total_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( smd_total_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "smd_total_available",
                    cppib_party_id_child,
                   cppib_party_id_parent
            FROM curr_exposure c
            GROUP BY
            party_name_child, party_name_parent, country_code_child, rtg_final_child, rtg_outlook_child,
    cppib_party_id_child, cppib_party_id_parent--, 'N', coalesce( rtg_final_child, '0' ), coalesce( rtg_outlook_child, '0' )
            ),
            breaches_under_parents_tbl AS
            (
                    SELECT
            cppib_party_id,
                --MIN( status ) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY LENGTH( status ) DESC) AS status
               DENSE_RANK () OVER(ORDER BY LENGTH(status) DESC) as state, status
             --MIN(STATUS) as STATUS
            FROM
                    (
                            SELECT
                            cppib_party_id_parent AS "cppib_party_id",
                            CASE
                           WHEN
                           ((NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_exposure,'\-')) and (NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_smd_limit,'\-')) and (CAST(total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL) >= CAST(total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL)))

                          WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_exposure,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_smd_limit,'\-') and ( CAST (total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST(total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( CAST(total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_der_repo_sbl_exposure,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,'\-') and ( CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND(CAST  (total_der_repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND(CAST  (total_der_repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(isrc_total_limit,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(isrc_total_exposure,'\-') and ( CAST (isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
