WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date

),

           MAX(dt_date)        AS last_updated,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation
     WHERE dt_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,

),
latest_allocations_and_commitments AS (

           ca.dt_date              AS last_updated,
           ca.as_of_date,
           ca.business_date,
           ca.allocation,
           ca.current_allocation,

               ELSE 0

      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation ca
INNER JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates cad

 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_ownership                own  ON own.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND own.business_date = ild.business_date AND own.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df2.business_date = ild.business_date AND df2.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df3.business_date = ild.business_date AND df3.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date

 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND lie.business_date = ild.business_date AND lie.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date
       AND yo.as_of_date = lyod.as_of_date
),
latest_local_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           allocation,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_3
),
latest_cad_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           cad_allocation,
           geographic_focus,
           exposure,
           occupied_area,
           total_area,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_2
),
latest_local_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)                        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           gross_invested_equity,
           reversal_of_previously_invested,
           expenses_inside_commitment,
           temporary_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit_a
),
latest_cad_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           gross_invested_equity,
           temporary_roc,
           permanent_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit
),
latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(dt_date)        AS last_updated,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation
     WHERE dt_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_allocations_and_commitments AS (
    SELECT TRIM(ca.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           ca.dt_date              AS last_updated,
           ca.as_of_date,
           ca.business_date,
           ca.allocation,
           ca.current_allocation,
           ca.commitments,
           ca.current_commitment,
           CASE 
               WHEN ca.allocation != 0 
               THEN ca.allocation - ca.commitments
               ELSE 0
           END                     AS uncommitted_allocation
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation ca
INNER JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates cad 
        ON cad.asset_code    = TRIM(ca.asset_code)
       AND cad.last_updated  = ca.dt_date
       AND cad.business_date = ca.business_date
       AND cad.as_of_date    = ca.as_of_date
),
latest_yardi_investment_level_details AS (

           allocation_name_il,

           al_investment_name,

           il_governance_structure_level_1,
           il_governance_structure_level_2
           investment_stage_current_il,
           country_exposure_il,
           currency_exposure_il,
           market_type,
           country_region_il,

      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE i_level = 'IL'
),
latest_yardi_deals AS (
    SELECT ild.asset_code,
           ild.as_of_date,
           ild.business_date,
           ild.model_portfolio_id,
           ild.debt_model_portfolio_id,
           ild.reporting_name,
           ild.investment_name,
           ild.investment_description,
           ild.investment_type_il,
           ild.investment_agg_il,
           ild.allocation_name_il,
           own.cppib_ownership_perc,
           ild.il_governance_structure_level_1,
           ild.investment_stage_current_il,
           ild.country_exposure_il,
           ild.currency_exposure_il,
           ild.country_region_il,
           ild.market_type,
           df2.geographic_focus,
           ild.sector_focus_level_1_il,
           ild.sector_focus_level_2_il,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_1,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_2,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_3,
           ild.reporting_currency_il,
           ild.investment_count_il,
           ild.emerging_market_il,
           ild.investment_manager_il,
           ac.allocation * fx.rate                            AS allocations_current,
           ac.commitments * fx.rate                           AS commitments_current,
           ac.uncommitted_allocation * fx.rate                AS uncommitted_allocation_current,
           lie.gross_invested_equity * fx.rate                AS gross_invested_equity_current,
           lie.expenses_inside_commitment * fx.rate           AS expenses_inside_commitment_current,
           df3.capital_additions * fx.rate                    AS capital_additions_current,
           lie.temporary_roc * fx.rate                        AS temporary_roc_current,
           lie.reversal_of_previously_invested * fx.rate      AS reversal_of_previously_invested_current,
           ie.gross_invested_equity                           AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
           ie.temporary_roc                                   AS temporary_roc_cad,
           ie.permanent_roc                                   AS permanent_roc_cad,
           ie.net_invested_equity                             AS net_invested_equity_base_currency,
           lie.net_invested_equity                            AS net_invested_equity_local_currency,
           df2.commitment                                     AS commitment_base_currency,
           df3.commitment                                     AS commitment_local_currency,
           df2.cad_allocation                                 AS allocation_base_currency,
           df3.allocation                                     AS allocation_local_currency,
           df2.asset_carrying_value                           AS carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.asset_carrying_value                           AS carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.debt_carrying_value                            AS debt_carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.debt_carrying_value                            AS debt_carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.equity_carrying_value                          AS equity_carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.equity_carrying_value                          AS equity_carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_base_currency,
           df3.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_local_currency,
           df2.occupied_area,
           df2.total_area
      FROM latest_yardi_investment_level_details ild
 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_ownership                own  ON own.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND own.business_date = ild.business_date AND own.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df2.business_date = ild.business_date AND df2.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df3.business_date = ild.business_date AND df3.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_invested_equity            ie   ON ie.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ie.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ie.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND lie.business_date = ild.business_date AND lie.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitments    ac   ON ac.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ac.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ac.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_fx_rates                       fx   ON fx.currency    = ild.reporting_currency_il AND fx.business_date  = ild.business_date AND fx.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date           
),
latest_yardi_deals_with_derived_fields AS (

              FROM (SELECT *,

                              + expenses_inside_commitment_current
                              - capital_additions_current
                              + temporary_roc_current 
                              + reversal_of_previously_invested_current

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (

           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code

       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date

 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df2.business_date = ild.business_date AND df2.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df3.business_date = ild.business_date AND df3.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_invested_equity            ie   ON ie.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ie.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ie.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND lie.business_date = ild.business_date AND lie.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,

      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (

           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc

INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,

      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx

latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date

latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd

       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code

       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date

           unfunded_commitment_cad,

           allocation,

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date
       AND yo.as_of_date = lyod.as_of_date
),
latest_local_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           allocation,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_3
),
latest_cad_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,

           equity_carrying_value,

           business_date,

           reversal_of_previously_invested,

),
latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(dt_date)        AS last_updated,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation
     WHERE dt_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_allocations_and_commitments AS (
    SELECT TRIM(ca.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           ca.dt_date              AS last_updated,
           ca.as_of_date,
           ca.business_date,
           ca.allocation,
           ca.current_allocation,
           ca.commitments,
           ca.current_commitment,
           CASE 
               WHEN ca.allocation != 0

               ELSE 0

      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation ca
INNER JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates cad

 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND lie.business_date = ild.business_date AND lie.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date
       AND yo.as_of_date = lyod.as_of_date
),
latest_local_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           allocation,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_3
),
latest_cad_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           cad_allocation,
           geographic_focus,

           occupied_area,

latest_local_invested_equity AS (

           business_date,
           gross_invested_equity,
           reversal_of_previously_invested,
           expenses_inside_commitment,
           temporary_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit_a
),
latest_cad_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,

           gross_invested_equity,
           temporary_roc,
           permanent_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit
),
latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(dt_date)        AS last_updated,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation
     WHERE dt_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_allocations_and_commitments AS (
    SELECT TRIM(ca.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           ca.dt_date              AS last_updated,
           ca.as_of_date,
           ca.business_date,
           ca.allocation,
           ca.current_allocation,
           ca.commitments,
           ca.current_commitment,
           CASE 
               WHEN ca.allocation != 0 
               THEN ca.allocation - ca.commitments
               ELSE 0
           END                     AS uncommitted_allocation
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation ca
INNER JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates cad 
        ON cad.asset_code    = TRIM(ca.asset_code)

       AND cad.business_date = ca.business_date

           df3.capital_additions * fx.rate                    AS capital_additions_current,

           df2.commitment                                     AS commitment_base_currency,
           df3.commitment                                     AS commitment_local_currency,
           df2.cad_allocation                                 AS allocation_base_currency,
           df3.allocation                                     AS allocation_local_currency,

           df3.asset_carrying_value                           AS carrying_value_local_currency,

           df3.debt_carrying_value                            AS debt_carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.equity_carrying_value                          AS equity_carrying_value_base_currency,
           df3.equity_carrying_value                          AS equity_carrying_value_local_currency,
           df2.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_base_currency,
           df3.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_local_currency,
           df2.occupied_area,
           df2.total_area
      FROM latest_yardi_investment_level_details ild
 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_ownership                own  ON own.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND own.business_date = ild.business_date AND own.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df2.business_date = ild.business_date AND df2.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df3.business_date = ild.business_date AND df3.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_invested_equity            ie   ON ie.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ie.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ie.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND lie.business_date = ild.business_date AND lie.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitments    ac   ON ac.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ac.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ac.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_fx_rates                       fx   ON fx.currency    = ild.reporting_currency_il AND fx.business_date  = ild.business_date AND fx.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date           
),
latest_yardi_deals_with_derived_fields AS (
    SELECT *,
           (
              equity_carrying_value_base_currency
            + unfunded_commitment_current
           )                                                             AS equity_exposure
      FROM (SELECT *,
                   (
                      commitments_current
                    - invested_commitment_current
                   )                                                     AS unfunded_commitment_current 
              FROM (SELECT *,
                         (
                                gross_invested_equity_current 
                              + expenses_inside_commitment_current
                              - capital_additions_current
                              + temporary_roc_current 
                              + reversal_of_previously_invested_current
                         )                                               AS invested_commitment_current

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx

latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date

latest_yardi_ownership AS (

           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx

latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,

  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date
       AND yo.as_of_date = lyod.as_of_date

latest_local_data_file AS (

           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           allocation,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_3

 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df2.business_date = ild.business_date AND df2.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df3.business_date = ild.business_date AND df3.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_invested_equity            ie   ON ie.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ie.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ie.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND lie.business_date = ild.business_date AND lie.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (

           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date
       AND yo.as_of_date = lyod.as_of_date
),
latest_local_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           allocation,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_3

    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,

           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,

           MAX(dt_date)        AS last_updated,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation
     WHERE dt_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY asset_code,

           business_date

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date
       AND yo.as_of_date = lyod.as_of_date
),
latest_local_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           allocation,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_3
),
latest_cad_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           commitment,
           cad_allocation,
           geographic_focus,
           exposure,
           occupied_area,
           total_area,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_2
),
latest_local_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)                        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           gross_invested_equity,
           reversal_of_previously_invested,
           expenses_inside_commitment,
           temporary_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit_a
),
latest_cad_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date,
           gross_invested_equity,
           temporary_roc,
           permanent_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit
),
latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(dt_date)        AS last_updated,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation
     WHERE dt_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_allocations_and_commitments AS (
    SELECT TRIM(ca.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           ca.dt_date              AS last_updated,
           ca.as_of_date,
           ca.business_date,
           ca.allocation,
           ca.current_allocation,
           ca.commitments,
           ca.current_commitment,
           CASE 
               WHEN ca.allocation != 0 
               THEN ca.allocation - ca.commitments
               ELSE 0
           END                     AS uncommitted_allocation
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation ca
INNER JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates cad 
        ON cad.asset_code    = TRIM(ca.asset_code)
       AND cad.last_updated  = ca.dt_date
       AND cad.business_date = ca.business_date
       AND cad.as_of_date    = ca.as_of_date

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date
       AND yo.as_of_date = lyod.as_of_date
),
latest_local_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           as_of_date,

           debt_carrying_value,

           unfunded_commitment_cad,

           allocation,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_3

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,

           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,

latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),

 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_ownership                own  ON own.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND own.business_date = ild.business_date AND own.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df2.business_date = ild.business_date AND df2.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df3.business_date = ild.business_date AND df3.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_invested_equity            ie   ON ie.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ie.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ie.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND lie.business_date = ild.business_date AND lie.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitments    ac   ON ac.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ac.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ac.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_fx_rates                       fx   ON fx.currency    = ild.reporting_currency_il AND fx.business_date  = ild.business_date AND fx.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date

                   (
                      commitments_current
                    - invested_commitment_current
                   )                                                     AS unfunded_commitment_current 
              FROM (SELECT *,
                         (

                              + expenses_inside_commitment_current
                              - capital_additions_current

                              + reversal_of_previously_invested_current

      )

WITH

    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc

       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code

 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_ownership                own  ON own.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND own.business_date = ild.business_date AND own.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df2.business_date = ild.business_date AND df2.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date

 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND lie.business_date = ild.business_date AND lie.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date

WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')) AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                          AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT model_portfolio_id,
           MAX(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY model_portfolio_id
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.model_portfolio_id,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.model_portfolio_id = mpc.model_portfolio_id
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           business_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
),
latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           as_of_date          AS as_of_date,
           business_date       AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
  GROUP BY asset_code,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
),
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.as_of_date,
           yo.business_date,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date

),
latest_local_data_file AS (

latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates AS (

           MAX(dt_date)        AS last_updated,
           as_of_date,
           business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation
     WHERE dt_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY asset_code,

),
latest_allocations_and_commitments AS (

           ca.dt_date              AS last_updated,
           ca.as_of_date,
           ca.business_date,
           ca.allocation,
           ca.current_allocation,

               ELSE 0

      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation ca
INNER JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates cad

 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_ownership                own  ON own.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND own.business_date = ild.business_date AND own.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df2.business_date = ild.business_date AND df2.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND df3.business_date = ild.business_date AND df3.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_invested_equity            ie   ON ie.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ie.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ie.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code            AND lie.business_date = ild.business_date AND lie.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date   
 LEFT JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitments    ac   ON ac.asset_code  = ild.asset_code            AND ac.business_date  = ild.business_date AND ac.as_of_date  = ild.as_of_date
